name: ddmal
description: DDMAL developer tooling for Claude Code. Skills: /ddmal:review-pr, /ddmal:handoff, /ddmal:resume, /ddmal:commit, /ddmal:draft-pr, /ddmal:draft-issue, /ddmal:daily-recap, /ddmal:weekly-recap. Backed by the GitHub MCP server, pinned read-only.

github_pat.title: GitHub personal access token (read-only)
github_pat.description: Fine-grained PAT with Read access to DDMAL repos (Issues, Pull requests, Contents, Discussions, Metadata). Stored in your OS keychain (or ~/.claude/.credentials.json) — never written to a repo. Authenticates the GitHub MCP server, which is additionally pinned read-only via X-MCP-Readonly, so a broader token still cannot write.
